title: Synthetic-Persona-Chat (SPC)
authors: Pegah Jandaghi, XiangHai Sheng, Xinyi Bai, Jay Pujara, Hakim Sidahmed (Google)
contents: Aggregate counts only: unigram counts (words seen 5+ times), message-opening words, and the top next words after one or two words (490,990 messages). No conversation text is shipped.
note: The corpus is LLM-generated casual English chit-chat, so it is a neutral prior; the user's own adaptive model always outranks it and hand-written Pidgin hints fill contexts it does not cover.
